title: agrostemma githago subsp. thessalum
intro: Agrostemma githago subsp. thessalum, commonly known as Corn Cockle, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. The Corn Cockle plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as arthritis and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Agrostemma githago subsp. thessalum are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been reported to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents of this plant.
